public_rationale: Marcus predicted that no one would retrain GPT-3 on a corpus with all references to the false-belief experiments removed. A search found no such experiment. The closest work studies other models or analyzes training checkpoints without removing data. The forecast has no deadline, and the fact that no study has appeared yet is not a decisive event. So the claim stays open.
limitations: One search was run. A small ablation study could have been missed.
Absence of an event cannot settle an open-ended forecast.
